notes: Conservative defaults for NyayaGrid corpus refresh scheduling.
Interval days are minimum spacing between automated refresh attempts; manual-only has no scheduler.

appliesTo: States with adapter_available and high refreshFeasibility
regulatory_frequent.notes: Federal eCFR updates continuously; weekly check balances freshness vs. API load. State regs with stable HTML adapters may use 14-day override per jurisdiction.

statute_periodic.notes: Session-law-driven; quarterly refresh unless jurisdiction signals mid-session codification update.

appliesTo: State court rules with official HTML hubs
court_rules_periodic.notes: Rules amend less frequently than regulations; semi-annual check unless court order amends tracked rule set.

appliesTo: State and federal constitutional provisions in seed corpus
constitution_static.notes: Amendments are rare; annual verification sufficient unless amendment ballot pending.

manual_only.notes: No automated refresh; human-curated snapshot or licensed source required before re-ingest.
